original_query: Build a regression model to predict 'Preqin Median Net IRR' using 'Vintage' and 'LN PME Using S&P 500 TR' as independent variables.
optimized_code:
import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm

# Data Loading
df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')

# Check for missing values
if df.isnull().values.any():
    df = df.dropna()

# Data Processing
X = df[['Vintage', 'LN PME Using S&P 500 TR']]
X = sm.add_constant(X)  # Adds a constant term to the predictor
Y = df['Preqin Median Net IRR']

# Ensure data types are correct
X = X.astype(float)
Y = Y.astype(float)

# Statistical Analysis
model = sm.OLS(Y, X).fit()

# Execution
print(model.summary())
